programmes.t: Voices of the Battle of Britain
programmes.d: As Winston Churchill said, 'Never was so much owed by so many to so few.' The RAF Veterans of the Battle of Britain tell their harrowing and incredible stories as they fought for the very existence of England

programmes.t: World War II: The Sound and The Fury
programmes.d: Germany's invasion of Poland sparks global war. Blitzkrieg crushes France; Britain stands alone. Japan expands across Asia, exploiting colonial weakness. In China, resistance grinds on.

programmes.t: World War II: The Sound and The Fury
programmes.d: Hitler invades the Soviet Union, but Moscow holds. Japan bombs Pearl Harbor, drawing the U.S. into war. Global conflict escalates as genocide and total destruction define the Axis war machine.

programmes.t: World War II: The Sound and The Fury
programmes.d: Stalingrad breaks the Nazi advance; Japan falters at Guadalcanal. The tide begins to turn. Mussolini falls as Allies land in Sicily. The Soviets crush Germany at Kursk.

programmes.t: World War II: The Sound and The Fury
programmes.d: D-Day lands Allied troops in Normandy; in the East, Operation Bagration devastates Germany. Paris is freed. Stalin secures Eastern Europe. In 1945, Berlin falls and Hitler dies.

programmes.t: World War II: The Last Heroes
programmes.d: Allied soldiers push on to take their first objective, the city of Caen. They're met by formidable Panzer forces determined to push the Allies back into the sea.
The Battle of Kursk comes to a climax at the Russian village of Prokhorovka on July 12, 1943.

In 1950 the world is caught off guard as North Korea launches a massive armored assault into South Korea. This is the story of the American tankers who rush to the aid of the South and the bloody battles they fight up and down the Korean Peninsula.

In 1916 the British debut a new mobile weapon hoping to break the long bloody stalemate on the Western Front. This is the story of the first tanks and how they change the face of the modern battlefield forever.

At the outset of WWII, the Germans pioneer a new form of mobile armored warfare. This is the story of the famed Nazi Blitzkrieg, as thousands of panzers burst through terrain thought impossible to conquer Western Europe in a matter of weeks.

In 1943, tanks of the Canadian Armoured Corps make their combat debut on the European mainland. This is the story of the Canadian tankers who fight their way up the Italian peninsula in the push to liberate Rome from Nazi occupation.
Women became unlikely heroes who fought behind enemy lines in every conflict of WWII. Many have sacrificed and paid the ultimate price.
Born of great desperation and used under the cover of darkness, special tools of spies and espionage agents delivered war to the heart of the enemy.
Learn more about the Nazis and their heavily organized plunder of these riches that would ultimately become the most gigantic heist in history.
Learn about the code breaking and stealing that took place during the longest and most crucial water battle in WWII between Germany and the Allies.
